items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: We had Ricard Ellis. ... William and Ricard Ellis was the fourth. ... And then I played by the fellow with the third. And then Johnny Henry with the third. And then I went with Punch... where he was taking Jack's whole band.

ctx.x: . And we had this fellow, William Padjo. You can get him. Yeah, yeah. We had him, right? He was going to school at that time. But he was a good reader, but he couldn't jazz. So we got Ricard Ellis. And then Willie Edwards, we had Willie Edwards. Then we had George McCullen for a little while. I forget this fellow. I wanted to spell it, but I thought I could remember. Du Conger. I couldn't make it out.
